'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Greg Shaw LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet title NOT.

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Feel The Conflict|There Is Good In Him]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
